subject: Armature Health — Transition notes, open decisions & owner matrix
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@armaturehealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@armaturehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Armature signed — sales summary + handoff asks

Team — quick thread to pass the baton for Armature Health (signed this morning). High-level summary and open items for CS/Implementation below. Attaching the latest SOW and the mutual action plan.

Deal snapshot
- ACV: $420k first year (RDW-DEAL-8792)
- Product: Redwood Dedicated + 2 model variants (ft-embed-xxl for embeddings; chat-curie-rt for streaming chat)
- Commitment: 2 reserved GPU nodes (p3-equivalent) with burst allowance; target steady-state qps: 220 embedding requests/minute; chat 120 concurrent sessions
- Go-live target: pilot staging by 2027-06-28, production by 2027-07-26

Key contractual/technical notes
- KMS: customer will use AWS KMS; they requested an integration pattern and list of required IAM roles (see attachment: Armature_SOW_v2.pdf)
- Data residency: US-only — no EU routing
- SLAs: 99.9% uptime for dedicated capacity; latency SLO 150ms p50 on chat tokens for region us-west-2
- Security questionnaire: they provided a vendor security addendum and want SOC2 artifacts (we already shared recent SOC2 report; procurement flagged log retention policy as follow-up)

Open items for CS / Implementation
1) Kickoff owner: need CS lead to run kickoff and own the MOP.
2) Technical lead: who will coordinate VPC peering / network topology with Armature infra and set up NAT/IP allowlisting (Pivotal Metrics requires IP allowlist for analytics calls).
3) Staging environment: confirm whether they prefer our hosted staging or want a customer VPC test cluster (their infra team asked about dedicated staging nodes).
4) Training plan: initial enablement for SRE + data-science teams (Marissa to own content).
5) Procurement: procurement contact is procure@armaturehealth.com — billing PO pending; finance wants to confirm invoice cadence (monthly after go-live).

Attachments: Armature_SOW_v2.pdf, armature-deployment-checklist.xlsx, ARM_mutual-action-plan.docx

Asks
- Vanessa: please propose a kickoff date range and assign CS lead + technical owner.
- Karthik: please confirm billing/PO chase point and if we need Salesforce/HubSpot updates beyond the attached MOM.

Thanks — I’ll stay on the thread through the first two weeks of onboarding to unblock procurement and any redlines.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@armaturehealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@armaturehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Armature signed — sales summary + handoff asks

Thanks Ben — congrats on the close. High level notes and clarifying Qs below. I’ll draft the kickoff agenda once we confirm a date.

Quick clarifications (need responses from Armature / Sales):
- KMS: do they want us to manage keys via cross-account role or will they provide a customer-managed CMK we reference? (need explicit IAM role names)
- Staging preference: does Armature want a customer VPC test cluster or to use our shared staging? This affects IP allowlist & networking timing.
- Pivotal Metrics: is this analytics vendor shipping data to a third-party endpoint or simply collecting metrics on-prem? If third-party, we’ll need to document flow for legal.

Proposed owner matrix (draft)
- CS Lead (overall kickoff & adoption owner): Vanessa Ortiz — schedule, success plan, post-go-live Q30 metrics
- Implementation Technical Lead (networking, peering, staging): Karthik Iyer — VPC peering, NAT, IP allowlist, KMS IAM role setup
- Enablement (trainings + runbooks): Marissa Cole — create runbook, host SRE/DS enablement session, recordables
- AE point (procurement & escalation): Ben Carter — billing/PO and exec escalations

Immediate next steps
- Can Ben ask procurement to share the PO timeline and the signed SOW PDF (final redlines accepted)?
- Can Armature confirm the staging preference by EOD Wed 05/06 so we can reserve nodes if needed?

I’ll schedule a 60-minute kickoff in the 05/10–05/12 window (please flag conflicts).

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@armaturehealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@armaturehealth.com>, procure@armaturehealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Armature signed — sales summary + handoff asks

Vanessa — answers inline below. Quoting your questions for context.

> KMS: do they want us to manage keys via cross-account role or will they provide a customer-managed CMK we reference?
They confirmed today that Armature will provide a customer-managed CMK and expect us to use cross-account decrypt permissions. They will share the ARN and the IAM principal the week of 05/10 (Armature Security Lead: Lena).

> Staging preference: does Armature want a customer VPC test cluster or to use our shared staging?
They prefer a customer VPC test cluster for privacy reasons; they want identical networking to prod. That means we should plan for VPC peering and a short IP allowance window for the analytics vendor (Pivotal Metrics).

> Pivotal Metrics: is this analytics vendor shipping data to a third-party endpoint or simply collecting metrics on-prem?
Pivotal will collect telemetry and forward anonymized usage stats to their cloud endpoint (they will provide an IP range for allowlisting). Legal asked for the data flow diagram — they promised a diagram by 05/09.

Procurement/billing: procure@armaturehealth.com has the PO in draft with expected net-30 after go-live. I’ll follow up today to push to signed PDF. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8792

Attachments included: Armature_SOW_v2.pdf (final), armature-deployment-checklist.xlsx (first draft), ARM_mutual-action-plan.docx

I’ll coordinate with Lena to get the CMK ARN and the Pivotal Metrics CIDR/IP ranges.

—Ben

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@armaturehealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@armaturehealth.com>, procure@armaturehealth.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Armature signed — Transition confirmed & owners assigned

Thanks — this is helpful. Finalizing owners and next steps below; I’ll create the shared onboarding Drive and invite everyone.

Final owner matrix & immediate commitments
- CS Lead: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com) — schedule kickoff, success plan, weekly 30/60/90 checkpoints
- Implementation Tech Lead: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — VPC peering, IP allowlist, KMS cross-account setup; deliverable: network diagram + peer runbook by 2027-05-12
- Enablement Lead: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — SRE/DS training, runbook, recording; deliverable: enablement deck + ops runbook by 2027-05-19
- AE Exec Sponsor: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) — procurement escalation, exec comms, sign-off on PO; deliverable: signed PO or confirmed payment cadence by 2027-05-12

Immediate milestones (short timeline)
- 05/06 EOD: Armature confirms staging preference (customer VPC — confirmed by Ben)
- 05/09: Armature to provide Pivotal Metrics IPs + data flow diagram (Ben to chase)
- 05/10–05/12: Kickoff window (60 min) — propose 05/11 10:00 PT; Vanessa to create calendar invite
- 05/12: Karthik to deliver initial network diagram/runbook draft

Risks & mitigations
- Risk: IP allowlist window overlaps with firewall change freeze at Armature (their SRE said change freeze 05/08–05/11). Mitigation: we’ll ask for temporary exception and coordinate schedule; Karthik to own communication.
- Risk: SOC2 evidence gap for specific log retention policy requested by Armature Legal. Mitigation: Security will provide retention statement and point to current SOC2 artifacts; Ben to loop security if procurement stalls.

Next steps for me
- Create Drive folder + invite Armature + internal owners
- Create kickoff agenda and send invite for 05/11 10:00 PT (tentative)
- Kick off a short runbook template for Karthik & Marissa to populate

If no objections, I’ll lock the invite and mark these deliverables in the mutual-action-plan doc.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
